about: What omacode installs, downloads or relies on outside its own npm dependencies, with the licence of each, where it may be used, and whether what you make with it may be used commercially (roadmap A6-T9). Kept by hand; scripts/third-party.mjs adds the npm and Python dependencies and writes licenses/third-party.json and THIRD_PARTY.md. Every licence here was read from the package's own metadata or model card on 2026-11-24, not assumed.

fields.installedBy: the install.sh profile that installs it, 'downloaded' (fetched on first use by something installed), 'you' (omacode needs it but does not install it), or 'planned' (listed ahead of a release that will install it)
fields.territory: where the licence lets it be used: 'global' when the licence has no territorial limit
fields.commercialOutput: whether what you make with it may be used commercially: 'yes', 'n/a' (it makes nothing you keep), or a note
fields.attribution: what you owe when you pass it on
fields.telemetry: what it reports to its maker on its own, and how omacode turns it off ('not checked' where nobody has looked yet)

components.name: OpenCode
components.telemetry: none found in 2.2.5 (an embedded component honours DO_NOT_TRACK, which omacode sets)

components.name: bubblewrap
components.attribution: none for use; LGPL terms when redistributing it

components.name: llama.cpp (llama-server)
components.notes: taken from PATH (or LLAMA_SERVER) for the embedding service; omacode does not install it

components.name: GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide
components.notes: the decider's base model, downloaded on its first start when no tuned model ships

components.name: omacode guard model (tuned)
components.source: decider/models/ (trained locally on synthetic and public data, no journal content)
components.notes: not published; whether to publish the weights is the maintainer's open decision

components.name: gliner-guard-uniencoder
components.notes: the planned successor base (P6); not installed by 1.0 yet

components.name: Qwen3-Embedding (0.6B, 4B, 8B GGUF)
components.notes: downloaded on the embedding service's first start

components.name: HyperFrames
components.telemetry: usage events to PostHog; off with HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK, which omacode sets on every run and agent shell

components.name: chrome-headless-shell (Chrome for Testing)
components.notes: HyperFrames downloads it on first use

components.name: ComfyUI
components.commercialOutput: yes for ComfyUI itself; the image model's licence decides (the model registry checks it before every run)
components.attribution: GPL terms when you redistribute ComfyUI; none for images
components.notes: a separate program omacode talks to over HTTP; LICENSE is GPL v3 with no 'or later' grant found

components.name: PyTorch (in ComfyUI's environment)
components.spdx: Apache-2.0 AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSL-1.0 AND MIT

components.name: comfy-cli
components.notes: installs and manages ComfyUI; a separate program
components.telemetry: usage tracking; omacode turns it off at install (comfy tracking disable)

components.name: comfy-mcp
components.attribution: AGPL terms when you modify it and offer it to others over a network
components.notes: a separate program OpenCode starts as an MCP server; used unmodified
